card.line: Egypt is the land of the Nile, where Joseph rose to power, Jacob's family grew into a nation, and God later brought Israel out.

moments.title: Joseph Sold to Egypt
moments.text: Joseph's brothers sold him to traders who took him down to Egypt. There the Midianites sold him to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh.

moments.title: Joseph Placed Over Egypt
moments.text: Pharaoh put Joseph in charge of all the land of Egypt. Joseph then stored up food in the cities during the seven years of plenty.

moments.title: God Sends Jacob to Egypt
moments.text: God told Jacob not to be afraid to go down to Egypt, and promised to make his family a great nation there. Jacob and all his offspring went.

moments.title: The Midwives Fear God
moments.text: A new king who did not know Joseph came to power. He ordered the Hebrew midwives to kill baby boys, but they feared God and let the boys live.

moments.title: The Exodus
moments.text: At midnight the LORD struck down every firstborn in Egypt, and the Egyptians urged Israel to leave. After 430 years, the LORD's people went out of Egypt.
